title: SkillOpt paper (arXiv 2605.23904) — Introduction
snippet: We formulate agent-skill learning as optimization over an external natural-language state and introduce SkillOpt, a harness-agnostic optimizer

title: How Microsoft Rewrites skills.md Files To Boost LLM Agents 25% (YouTube)
snippet: bounded add/delete/replace edits on a single skill markdown file, and accepts an edit only if it strictly improves a held-out validation

title: microsoft/skillopt (GitHub)
snippet: text-space optimizer that trains reusable natural-language skills for frozen LLM agents through trajectory-driven edits, validation-gated updates

title: Self-Supervised Skill Optimization (arXiv 2607.28777)
snippet: GT-free skill optimization: optimizing a reusable skill for a frozen LLM agent from unlabeled task instances alone

title: Microsoft's open-source SkillOpt (VentureBeat)
snippet: The edit budget acts as a learning rate. By limiting how many edits can be applied at once, the skill avoids overshooting; per-task budget caps and maximum iteration limits recommended

title: Skill Set Optimization: Reinforcing Language Model Behavior via Transferable Skills (AllenAI)
snippet: constructing and refining sets of transferable skills for LLM actors
